claim: MEDDPICC has eight criteria and extends MEDDIC with Paper Process and Competition.
quote: The name is an acronym for eight qualification criteria: Metrics, Economic Buyer, Decision Criteria, Decision Process, Paper Process, Identify Pain, Champion, and Competition.
title: Altify: MEDDPICC for Enterprise Sellers

claim: MEDDPICC defines the Economic Buyer as the person who can release budget; title is an unreliable proxy.
quote: The Economic Buyer is the person with the authority to release budget for the purchase.
title: Altify: MEDDPICC

claim: MEDDPICC Paper Process covers legal, security and procurement steps after the decision.
quote: Paper Process covers the legal, security, and procurement steps required to execute a contract after the buying decision is made: redlines, security review, MSA negotiation, PO issuance.
title: Altify: MEDDPICC

claim: MEDDPICC Identify Pain requires a specific business problem with a stated cost of inaction.
quote: Identify Pain is the specific business problem driving the buyer to act, tied to a cost of inaction the buyer has stated in their own words.
title: Altify: MEDDPICC

claim: MEDDPICC Competition includes the status quo and build-in-house, not only named vendors (i.e. existing vendors).
quote: Competition is every alternative the buyer is weighing, including internal status quo, a build-it-yourself option, and named competitors.
title: Altify: MEDDPICC

claim: BANT assesses Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline.
quote: Budget (the prospect’s ability to afford the product), Authority (the prospect’s ability to make the final decision), Need (whether the prospect has a need your product solves), Timeline (how quickly the purchase needs to take place).
title: Pipedrive: Is BANT still effective

claim: Main criticism of BANT is that it is outdated for modern sales (vendor opinion).
quote: The main criticism against the BANT qualification framework is that it’s outdated in the context of modern sales.
title: Pipedrive: BANT

claim: Pipedrive recommends reframing Authority from who decides to who is involved in the decision.
quote: The concept of Authority needs to shift from “Who makes the call” to “Who is involved in the decision?”
title: Pipedrive: BANT

claim: A practitioner checklist treats new leaders as a strong buying trigger.
quote: New leaders are one of the strongest buying triggers in B2B sales.
title: Salesmotion account research checklist

claim: Existing-vendor knowledge changes the sales motion from greenfield to displacement.
quote: If they are already using a competitor, your conversation is about displacement, not greenfield adoption.
title: Salesmotion account research checklist

claim: Earnings call transcripts are suggested as a source of stated priorities.
quote: Earnings call transcripts are an underrated gold mine.
title: Salesmotion account research checklist

claim: Checklist advice: build a value hypothesis mapping a stated priority to an outcome the service delivers (service fit).
quote: Build a simple value hypothesis for the account before you reach out.
title: Salesmotion account research checklist

claim: A commercial-services checklist says generic SaaS-oriented checklists do not fit services; the checklist must change with the offering.
quote: Generic pre-call checklists don't work for commercial services.
title: Convex pre-call research checklist for commercial services

claim: Vendor survey reports 91.6% of respondents felt pre-meeting research significantly affected call success; perception only, not win rate. Not found in cached page; from search snippet.
quote: 91.6% of respondents agreed that pre-meeting research significantly impacted their calls' success rates
title: Cirrus Insight: sales preparation
